relabelled.note: Interpretation corrected, measurements untouched and not re-run. Every measured field below is byte-identical to the original capture. What changed is what the run is claimed to prove: it is fast-transport seam evidence, not settlement latency, and the EOA emitter means it does not exercise the locked peer-emitter path. See ADR-0012 and ADR-0013.

proves: Wormhole network availability between Monad Testnet and Base Sepolia
destination Core acceptance of a guardian-signed message from the other chain
doesNotProve: Conduit's locked peer-emitter path: the emitter here is an EOA, not RWACVASettlementAdapter or SettlementCoordinator
deployment ID, protocol version, message type, settlement ID, intent hash, or replay consumption, all of which are enforced in WormholeTransport rather than in the Core contract
settlement latency: these timings are transport latency at a non-final consistency level
consistencyNote: Instant (200): guardians sign on observation, before the source state is irreversible. Conduit refuses this level for anything that authorizes value and enforces FINALIZED on chain per message class (ADR-0013). Base's finalized path is 512 blocks at ~2s, roughly eighteen minutes.
